name: words-memo-backend
description: Account + sync server for the wordsLearning app (NestJS, TypeORM, PostgreSQL)

scripts.migration:generate: npm run build && typeorm migration:generate -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.migration:run: npm run build && typeorm migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.migration:revert: npm run build && typeorm migration:revert -d dist/database/data-source.js
